blocks.text: DNA har jaandaar cell ke nucleus mein hota hai. Yeh proteins banane ka code shuda mansooba, yani naqsha (blueprint), hai, aur proteins zindagi ke liye zaroori hain. Har khaas protein aik khaas gene se banta hai; gene DNA ka aik hissa hai (Figure 27.14). Kisi jaandaar ki genetic maloomat DNA molecules mein jama hoti hai, jo tamam jaandaron ki nashonuma, kaam, barhne aur tolid (reproduction) ki hidayaat rakhte hain. DNA ki double helix banawat apne chaar mukhtalif nitrogen wale bases ki tarteeb (sequence) ke zariye maloomat jama karti hai aur proteins banane ke liye yeh maloomat tezi aur durusti se aage pohanchati hai.

Genes bari units mein munazzam hote hain jinhein chromosomes kehte hain; insaan ko walidain se chromosomes ke 23 jore milte hain. Jism ke taqreeban har cell mein 23 joron ka poora set hota hai, phir bhi har qism ka cell sirf apne kaam ke khaas genes chalu (switch on) karta hai. Maslan laal khoon ka cell haemoglobin ka gene chalu karta hai aur keratin ka gene band rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ka jumla 'each cell is a different specific pectine' chhapai mein bigra hua lagta hai. Is ka matlab yahi hai ke har cell sab genes nahi, balke apne kaam ke khaas genes istemal karta hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch jure daire, har aik pichhle ka qareebi manzar: nucleus wala cell (genome, cell ke nucleus mein); chromosome (insaani cell mein 23 jore); chromosome ka hissa jis mein aik gene nishaan zada (chromosome ka hissa jo aik protein banata); DNA double helix (shakar-phosphate zanjeer se jure bases ki polymer zanjeerein); aur reerh par teen bases G, T, A (codon, teen bases ka group jo aik khaas amino acid ka code hai).
blocks.caption: Figure 27.14: DNA; genome se codon tak (kitab ki Figure 27.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 1953 mein James Watson aur Francis Crick ne dikhaya ke DNA do polynucleotide zanjeeron se bana hai. Har zanjeer daen haath wala (right-handed) spiral (helix) banati hai aur dono zanjeerein aik doosre ke gird lipat kar double helix banati hain. Dono zanjeerein aik jaisi nahi balke base pairing ki wajah se aik doosre ke ulat (opposite) hain, yani aik ka 3' sira doosri ke 5' sire ke saamne hota hai. Har zanjeer ki sugar-phosphate reerh (backbone) hai jis se bases seedhe zaviye (right angle) par bahar nikalte hain aur doosri zanjeer ke bases se kamzor hydrogen bonds se jure rehte hain. Adenine (A) hamesha thymine (T) ke saamne hota hai, aur guanine (G) cytosine (C) ke saamne. A aur T ke jore mein do hydrogen bonds aur G aur C ke jore mein teen hydrogen bonds hote hain (Figure 27.15).

blocks.alt: Baen, base pairing: do khari shakar-phosphate reerhon (backbones) ke darmiyan aath jore, A-T, C-G, G-C, G-C, T-A, T-A, C-G, G-C; A-T do tooti lakeeron (hydrogen bonds) se aur G-C teen se jure. Daen, double helix: do reerh ke feete aik doosre ke gird lipte, darmiyan rangeen base jore.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.15: DNA ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 27.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tooti lakeerein hydrogen bonds hain: A aur T ke darmiyan do, G aur C ke darmiyan teen. Base pairing wali seedhi seerhi hi mur kar double helix banti hai: dono kinare sugar-phosphate reerh hain aur darmiyan ki pattiyan base jore.

Genes DNA ke woh khaas hisse hain jo genetic maloomat rakhte hain aur cell ko koi khaas protein banane ki hidayat dete hain. DNA ka aik ahem amal apni naqal khud banana (self-replication) hai. Replication cell cycle ka woh amal hai jis mein DNA copy hota hai, taa ke jab cell taqseem ho to har naye cell ko genetic maadde ka poora set mile. Is tarah genetic maloomat aik cell se us ke beti cells (daughter cells) aur agli nasal tak pohanchti hai.

blocks.prompt: A-T jore aur G-C jore ko kitne hydrogen bonds jorte hain?
blocks.explanation: A aur T ke darmiyan do; G aur C ke darmiyan teen.

items: DNA: do ulti simt wali polynucleotide zanjeerein, daen haath ki double helix (Watson aur Crick, 1953).
A–T (2 hydrogen bonds), G–C (3 hydrogen bonds).
Genes proteins ka code hain; cell taqseem se pehle DNA apni naqal (replication) banata hai.
